_about: How monsters think. The first four numbers are the old game's (aiTurn, lines 1740-1746). The rest are the smarter enemies of Phase 9 (owner, 2026-10-11): from smartFrom (bosses and elites from smartBossFrom) a monster prefers a hero it can defeat this turn, then healers, then heroes weak to its attack; from cautiousFrom it avoids ending its move next to two or more heroes when it can't attack. Floors before smartFrom play like the old game.
